world_news.headline: House prices falling in every Australian capital city for first time in 15 years
world_news.summary:
House prices in Sydney are at a two-year low after falling 4.7% in the September quarter to $1.66m, according to Domain report

  • Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast

House prices are falling across every capital city for the first time in 15 years and the second time on record, according to figures from Domain’s September Quarter 2026 House Price report.

House prices in Sydney are at a two-year low after falling 4.7% in the September quarter, to $1.66m.
